scheme_name: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Construction of Approach Road
other_conditions: Private sector entity or existing/operational industrial parks are eligible
Minimum of 5 acres of legally owned land (by direct purchase or lease from the State Government) is required
Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) must be registered under the Companies Act, Societies Registration Act, Partnership Act or LLP
Park area must be expanded to at least 5 acres in out‑lying districts and at least 2 acres in Kolkata and Howrah
Individual units must have obtained all necessary clearances for land conversion, fire licence, environmental compliance, building plan, etc.
benefits_summary: Construction of a two‑lane approach road up to 1.5 km connecting to a highway, provided free of cost.
